title: Convexity Implies Product Bound (Sorry Elimination)
description: Proves that log-convexity at prime graph vertices implies the product bound pₙ² > pₙ₋ᵢ·pₙ₊ᵢ, completing the formalization of Pomerance's 1979 proof of Erdős 453. Uses Real.log_mul, Real.log_pow, and Real.log_lt_log_iff from Mathlib.

Explicit verification of each Mathlib lemma used

overview.historicalContext: Pomerance (1979) proved Erdős Problem #453 by showing that at convex hull vertices of the prime number graph (n, log pₙ), the inequality pₙ² > pₙ₋ᵢ·pₙ₊ᵢ holds for all i. The key step converts a log inequality into a product inequality. This was previously left as a sorry in the parent formalization.
overview.problemStatement: Prove without sorry: if 2·log(pₙ) > log(pₙ₋ᵢ) + log(pₙ₊ᵢ) then pₙ² > pₙ₋ᵢ·pₙ₊ᵢ.
overview.text: Provides a clean, properly ordered proof that log-convexity at prime graph vertices implies the product bound, using Mathlib's logarithm lemmas.
overview.proofStrategy: Step 1: log(pₙ₋ᵢ · pₙ₊ᵢ) = log(pₙ₋ᵢ) + log(pₙ₊ᵢ) < 2·log(pₙ) = log(pₙ²) by hypothesis. Step 2: Since log is strictly monotone on (0,∞), pₙ₋ᵢ · pₙ₊ᵢ < pₙ². Step 3: Transfer from ℝ to ℤ.
keyInsights: The proof reduces to three Mathlib lemmas: log_mul, log_pow, log_lt_log_iff
The parent file had a forward reference issue (log_to_product defined after its caller)
Transferring from ℝ to ℤ requires careful cast handling
